title: Scalability
description: The system must be able to accommodate a large number of users and provide a seamless experience.

title: Usability
description: The system must be user-friendly and accessible for individuals with Dyslexia.

title: Adaptability
description: The system must be adaptable to the needs of individuals with Dyslexia.

title: Integration
description: The system must be integrated into existing educational practices.

title: Security
description: The system must ensure the security and confidentiality of user data.

title: Performance
description: The system must provide a fast and responsive experience for users.

title: Reliability
description: The system must be reliable and provide a consistent experience for users.

title: Maintainability
description: The system must be easy to maintain and update.

title: Testability
description: The system must be easy to test and validate.
